business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bulk Dehydrated Garlic Flakes and Crushed Chili Pepper Export

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (offshore international financial centre; International Company regime)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER-Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus; in force for Samoa since 2020)
Samoa–New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (2007)
No Samoa–PRC Bilateral Investment Treaty or Double Taxation Agreement is currently in force

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 2016 (as amended); Companies Act 2008 (general incorporation principles where applied); Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2017 and Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2018 (Know-Your-Business-Entity/KBE duties); Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018 (CDD, KYC and PEP obligations on reporting entities); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2000; Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act 2000 (international cooperation). Beneficial ownership returns are lodged in the non-public central register maintained by the Registrar of Companies; access is restricted to the Registrar, the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit, the Samoa Revenue Authority and foreign authorities acting pursuant to a TIEA or MOU.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each proposed shareholder, director, secretary and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of jurisdiction of origin (e.g., PRC notary office for Chinese principals)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille under the 1961 Apostille Convention (Samoa acceded in 2021; PRC-origin documents are apostilled by the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or registered agent of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; or consular legalization at a Samoa diplomatic mission for non-Convention source states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized board resolution of each corporate shareholder approving the Samoa IC incorporation and appointing subscribers/directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; or consular legalization where the Apostille Convention does not apply

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter for the proposed International Company bank account application
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank of the principal or beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Issued on bank letterhead under banker's authenticated signature; apostille not required but document must be dated within 90 days

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified English translation and romanized transliteration of the Chinese-language charter (Memorandum and Articles of Association) and Chinese trade name
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified translator (Samoa or jurisdiction of origin)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if issued offshore; otherwise verified by the licensed registered agent under MCIL standards

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based CDD under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018: identity and UBO verification of all principals; continuous screening against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN, UK HMT, EU CFSP and Samoan domestic designation lists at onboarding and on an ongoing basis; enhanced due diligence and source-of-funds verification for PEPs, PEP associates, and persons connected to FATF/APG-flagged high-risk jurisdictions; the licensed registered agent must document all screening evidence and retain records for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Registry — Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL); online filing via the MCIL Companies Registry portal (https://www.mcil.gov.ws)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory filings and the registered legal name must be in English/Roman script. A full Chinese-language Memorandum and Articles of Association is permitted as the operative internal charter, but a certified English translation must be filed with the Registrar, and the English version prevails for registration and legalization purposes. Non-Roman names require certified romanized transliteration. The registered name of a Samoa International Company must end with the suffix 'International Company', 'IC' or 'I.C.'
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: International Company (for entities not licensed as International Companies)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 working days of a written refusal, the applicant, acting through the licensed registered agent, may file a written review request with the Registrar of Companies, who must determine the review on the papers within 21 days. A further appeal lies to the Supreme Court of Samoa by way of judicial review within 30 days of the review decision. Alternatively, the applicant may submit a revised name reservation that includes a distinguishing word or element to satisfy the 'not identical or deceptively similar' test under the Companies Act 2008 and the International Companies Act 2016.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are not accepted as a registered office. A physical registered office in Samoa is mandatory at the premises of a licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act 2016. The International Company may, however, be managed and controlled wholly from abroad, and no Samoan employees or onshore physical business premises are otherwise required for this dehydrated-spices trading business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (approximately 10%) for this non-licensed, low-risk trading activity; the probability rises to approximately 30% if CDD flags a PEP, a sanctioned jurisdiction, or the licensed registered agent enters a supervisory inspection cycle conducted by the Registrar or the Financial Intelligence Unit.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name clearance application and International Company incorporation filing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Companies (Fees) Regulations (as amended); USD equivalent of WST

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory KBE compliance requirement; market administrative fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed professional fee; prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation and transliteration of Chinese charter and ancillary documents

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 1988–2018, particularly Part II (incorporation), Part III (registered office and registered agent) and Part IV (share capital); read together with the International Companies (Fees) Regulations and the exemption from the Business Licences Act 2011 for International Companies not carrying on domestic business.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa; administrative supervision and fee collection by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Registrar of International Companies; the Certificate of Incorporation is issued by the Registrar upon approval of the filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit requirement in Samoa; the Memorandum may declare shares in any currency, shares may be allotted as fully paid or partly paid, and the licensed registered agent must verify the initial share subscription records.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST WRITTEN BOARD RESOLUTION OF [WS_IC INTERNATIONAL COMPANY LIMITED]. The subscribers/directors waive notice and, relying on the Certificate of Incorporation, resolve: (1) the subscriptions to ordinary shares stated in the Memorandum be accepted and 1,000 shares of US$1.00 each be allotted fully paid; (2) the registered office place in Samoa, as designated by the registered agent, be adopted; (3) the licensed registered agent be and is hereby formally appointed; (4) [Director A] be appointed Managing Director and [Director B] be appointed Secretary, jointly authorised to open bank accounts and execute bills of lading and sale contracts. Effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Search and Reservation of Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA / Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Apia (online name reservation window administered by SIFA).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Samoan registered agent; conduct an availability search through SIFA's name reservation portal; submit Application for Reservation of Name specifying the proposed English name with the 'Limited' suffix; pay the reservation fee by wire or SIFA e-payment; hold the reservation for 60 calendar days pending incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Application for Reservation of Name (signed by applicant or registered agent)
Registered agent engagement letter
Copy of beneficial owner and/or incorporator passport or national ID
Proposed company name and two ranked alternative names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for identity or confusing similarity, file a fresh reservation using the ranked alternatives; a written reconsideration request may be submitted to the Registrar within 14 days, and any administrative refusal can be cured by adopting a distinctive new suffix or modified trading style.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Filing of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, MCIL, Apia (filing submitted electronically or in person through the licensed registered agent).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in compliance with the International Companies Act 1987, obtains subscriber signatures, executes the Declaration of Compliance, and files the full package with the Registrar together with the consent of the registered agent and the first director details.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed by subscribers)
Declaration of Compliance by the subscriber(s) or incorporator
Consent of registered agent to act
List of first directors and consented officer details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a defect or query notice, the registered agent corrects the formal defect and re-files within 21 days; resubmission is normally accepted without penalty, and an incorrect rejection may be appealed to SIFA in writing within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of State Fees and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA fee collection window and Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the official incorporation fee and the first-year annual license fee to the Government of Samoa consolidated account through SIFA; the Registrar endorses the Memorandum and Articles and issues the Certificate of Incorporation; the licensed agent collects the original certificate and certified copies from the Registry.
required_dossiers: Government fee payment receipt from SIFA
Endorsed Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with Registrar
Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
Consent of registered agent and registered office address confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains typographical or name deviations, file a Certificate of Correction application supported by a rectifying board resolution; the corrected certificate is ordinarily reissued within 5 business days without re-opening the substantive filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of Registered Office and Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent's licensed office in Samoa (registered agent acting under Part III of the International Companies Act 1987).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files Notice of Registered Office and its formal consent with the Registrar; the statutory registers of members, directors, secretary and charges are opened at the registered office in Samoa; the company records are placed under the custody of the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Notice of Registered Office (Form IC-RO) signed by the registered agent
Consent to act as registered agent (unless filed with incorporation docs)
Register of members and share transfers
Register of directors, secretary and officers
Register of charges and encumbrances
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries the registered office address, the agent supplies a certified copy of the office lease or letter of authorization from the premises owner; if no valid Samoan address can be established, appoint a replacement licensed agent and re-file the Notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Completion: First Board Resolution, Share Certificates and Bank Mandate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of WS_IC International Company Limited, in coordination with the registered agent and any Samoa-licensed international bank.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The directors adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution in writing, approve the allotment of shares, sign and issue share certificates, appoint bank signatories, and open the company's USD settlement account with a licensed international bank in Samoa; any inward capital remittance is evidenced in the corporate file for AML verification.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution (signed by all directors)
Share certificates issued and countersigned
Bank account opening forms, KYC and source-of-funds pack
Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or counterparty queries beneficial ownership or sanctions exposure, provide the ultimate beneficial owner declaration, trade counterparty list and notarized board minutes; if a bank rejects the mandate, amend the board resolution and resubmit within 7 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for this offshore International Company; domestic industrial licensing in Samoa is administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour under the Business Licences Act 2011, but an International Company without a physical domestic establishment is exempt from such licensing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required — the company operates as a tax-exempt offshore wholesale trader of dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper under the International Companies Act 1987 regime; no manufacturing or operational permit is issued or needed for the trading scope.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa, through the Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Not triggered — the registered activity is pure offshore trading with no land-disturbing undertaking in Samoa; should any warehouse, repacking or dehydration facility be established domestically, a Preliminary Environmental Assessment would become mandatory under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the current trading model; if a Samoan physical facility is later created, wastewater, VOC emissions and solid waste must comply with MNRE Water Quality Standards, the Natural Resources and Environment (Waste Management) Regulations, and applicable ambient air limits — no discharge obligations attach to a paper-only offshore trading company.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — the International Company occupies no physical premises in Samoa and employs no domestic workforce; if an administrative office or warehouse were later established, the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority fire safety certificate, PUMA structural clearance, and MCIL Occupational Safety and Health registration would be required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MaF), Government of Samoa; taxpayer portal: 'Oloa' e-Services (https://www.mof.gov.ws); customs administration performed by the Samoa Customs Service, an operational division of the Ministry for Revenue, using ASYCUDA World.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Samoa International Company is statutorily exempt from income tax, VAGST and stamp duty under s.219 of the International Companies Act 1987 and is not required to obtain a TIN. Practical SOP: (1) incorporate with the Registrar of International Companies via the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation; (2) optionally apply to the Ministry for Revenue for a voluntary TIN to facilitate offshore bank account opening or foreign tax credit relief; (3) if the IC elects (or is required) to conduct domestic taxable activity, mandatory VAGST registration is required within 21 days after crossing the WST 100,000 annual taxable turnover threshold; for pure offshore dehydrated-spice trading, no registration is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Election under s.219(5) of the International Companies Act 1987 to opt into the Income Tax Act 2015 and the VAGST Act 2007, thereby becoming a resident taxable company on Samoa-source income only; election in the memorandum and articles to adopt the corporate law of a foreign jurisdiction for internal governance (Part IV, ICA 1987); no US-style check-the-box election and no BEPS Action 2 hybrid mismatch election exists because Samoa has not implemented hybrid mismatch legislation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 (annual taxable turnover in any 12-month period, s.10 VAGST Act 2007)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API clearance, or digital tax stamp regime exists. Taxpayers must file VAGST returns electronically through the Ministry for Revenue 'Oloa' portal. Export goods clearance is mandatory through ASYCUDA World, and physical inspection is risk-based; electronic customs declarations are required for all export consignments.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to a registered person's supply of goods that are exported from Samoa directly to a non-resident and are not subject to later Samoan VAGST, and to services supplied to a non-resident performed wholly or predominantly offshore (VAGST Act 2007). A Samoa International Company, being exempt from VAGST, is outside the charge to VAGST entirely; therefore no indirect tax is levied on its offshore bulk dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper sales, and no input VAT refund is claimable because no input VAT is incurred. To evidence eligibility, the exporter must hold a customs export declaration and documentary proof that the goods physically departed Samoa within 30 days.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World Cus-01 Entry)
Commercial Invoice (full description, customs value, Incoterms)
Bill of Lading (or Airway Bill / Sea Waybill)
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a Samoan licensed commercial bank
Certificate of Origin (when required by the destination jurisdiction)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Samoa Customs and the Ministry for Revenue may reassess zero-rated exports within five years of the supply. A false or fraudulent zero-rating claim triggers immediate clawback of the 15% VAGST, default interest at 12% per annum, and civil penalties of up to 200% of the tax liability for intentional evasion. Criminal liability under the Tax Administration Act 2015 exposes directors to fines up to WST 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to seven years. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days is a breach of the Exchange Control Regulations and can incur fines up to WST 100,000 or three times the unremitted amount, plus revocation of the IC's foreign investment or trading permits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is managed by the CBS under a discretionary managed-float arrangement. Current-account convertibility for bona fide trade and service transactions is generally available to resident businesses, but capital-account transactions involving resident persons and domestic regulated entities require CBS approval or a commercial bank foreign-exchange permit. An International Company under the International Companies Act 1988, as amended, is classified as a non-resident entity and benefits from a statutory exemption from all exchange-control restrictions: capital subscriptions, dividends, interest, management fees, and liquidation proceeds may be converted through a licensed commercial bank and repatriated offshore without CBS license or prior exchange-control approval. This creates full de facto convertibility for the WS_IC treasury footprint, subject only to bank-level AML/KYC verification and documentary substantiation of the underlying transaction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion ratio applies to a Samoan International Company. The International Companies Act 1988 (as amended) expressly displaces the Exchange Control Act 1975 and the Exchange Control Regulations with respect to international companies; therefore, export receipts earned by WS_IC from bulk dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper sales may be retained in non-WST currencies (USD, EUR, AUD, NZD) in offshore or onshore foreign-currency accounts without being required to be converted to WST or surrendered to the CBS. Resident counterparties remain subject to standard exchange-control repatriation timelines and any central-bank-imposed conversion obligations; WS_IC is outside that perimeter.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD/AUD/NZD) plus Foreign-Currency Transaction Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low: global fintech EMIs and digital cross-border payment platforms generally include Samoa in higher-risk OFC screening when the underlying entity is a tax-exempt International Company. EMIs may open payment/e-money accounts only where the IC can provide locally registered physical substance, audited financials, beneficial-ownership transparency to PICP depth and independent confirmation of the dehydrated-spices trade. The entity should therefore treat fintech EMIs as supplementary collection/disbursement rails, not as a substitute for a full commercial bank account with a licensed Samoan bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Most tier-1 licensed Samoan banks will require at least one director or an appointed authorised signatory with documented power of attorney to attend an in-person KYC interview at the branch or a recognised foreign representative office before account activation. Remote opening is possible only on a case-by-case basis for established non-resident shareholders with existing private-banking relationships; for a newly incorporated International Company owned by non-resident shareholders, a physical or video-verified KYC interview and notarised corporate resolutions are effectively mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt International Company with offshore beneficial owner(s) and no local directors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full corporate registry file (certificate of incorporation, charter, memorandum and articles), certificate of incumbency, register of directors and shareholders, beneficial-ownership declaration, valid passport copies, recent utility bills or bank references for each principal, together with a corporate-shareholding diagram and source-of-wealth statement for each 25%+ owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No meaningful commercial substance in Samoa or low operational footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed lease for a physical Samoan office, local administrative service provider engagement letter, payroll records of bookkeeping/trading staff, minutes of board meetings held in Samoa, list of substantive agreements with mainland-principal suppliers and overseas FOB buyers, and latest management accounts or audited financial statements evidencing active trading in dehydrated vegetables and spices.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party cross-border trade chain involving multiple intermediary jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed supply contracts, pro-forma invoices and purchase orders, warehouse receipts, bill of lading, air waybills or CMR, customs export declarations (Samoan customs), quality/inspection certificates (e.g. SGS or Bureau Veritas), letters from counterparties' banks confirming the commercial purpose, and a reconciliation showing the flow of funds corresponds to the physical flow of goods.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inward share-capital or shareholder-loan payments to the WS_IC account must be sent as a SWIFT MT103 through a licensed Samoan commercial bank or its overseas correspondent; the beneficiary should be named exactly as per the corporate account mandate and the remittance should use a clearly stated purpose code such as 'Share subscription - capital contribution to Samoa International Company' or 'Shareholder loan - deed-poll reference'. No CBS exchange-control license is required. The receiving bank will apply standard source-of-funds verification, so the remitter must provide the corporate bank with a board resolution, the shareholder register, and a funds-origin certificate before credit is posted; funds will typically be value-dated same-day for TAL/foreign-currency settlement, if T+0 clearing, otherwise T+1, in line with SWIFT and local clearing-house cut-offs.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For settlements with third-party suppliers, freight forwarders and overseas agents, the WS_IC treasury should use (i) commercial letters of credit issued on SWIFT MT700/MT710 by the Samoan bank's trade desk, with documents negotiated under UCP 600, for large bulk spice shipments; and (ii) SWIFT MT103 direct telegraphic transfers for smaller or regular payments to counterparties with established credit. Payments should be sourced only from the corresponding foreign-currency account funded by trade receivable collections, and all invoices, purchase orders and shipping documents must be file-matched to the payment instruction. Settlement to destinations such as mainland China, India and Vietnam will transit the bank's New York, Sydney or Auckland correspondent clearing network; the Samoan IC is not subject to surrender, but must observe the bank's FX ticket and transfer cut-off times.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts (USD/WST, AUD/WST, NZD/WST) with the licensed Samoan commercial bank under a documented treasury ISDA or master FX terms, limited to hedging of genuine commercial exposures from dehydrated-vegetable and spice trade flows.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on WST/USD executed with international bank treasury desks, net-settled in USD, provided the underlying trade payable/receivable is verifiable by the hedge provider.

Cross-currency swaps between USD and AUD/NZD arranged by the onshore bank's treasury team for structural management of receivables denominated in mixed Pacific and Asian currencies, again supported by documentary evidence of underlying trade flows.
Plain-vanilla foreign-currency options (vanilla FX options) on USD/WST or USD/AUD purchased with the bank, if required, to cap adverse currency movements without speculating.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company Renewal — Annual Government Fee Payment and Registered Agent Good-Standing Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) and Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each annual anniversary of incorporation; a 30-day statutory grace period applies before late penalties accrue; remittance is effected by the licensed registered agent.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: An additional penalty equal to 10% of the annual fee is imposed if payment is not made within one month of the anniversary; if the fee and penalties remain unpaid for six months after the due date, the Registrar may, after notice, administratively strike the International Company off the register, extinguishing legal personality; restoration requires settlement of all arrears, penalties and a reinstatement fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies (confidential beneficial ownership register) via the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation, filed concurrently with the annual renewal; interim update filings are required within 14 days after any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership or control.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-filing constitutes an offence under the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2023; the company and the registered agent are each exposed to monetary penalties per day of default and criminal fines for deliberate misstatement; persistent non-compliance impairs the company's good standing and may be treated as non-renewal, leading to administrative strike-off by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Maintenance and Production of Statutory Corporate Registers at the Registered Office (Register of Members, Register of Directors, Register of Charges, Minute Book)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered agent's office in Apia, Samoa; registers must be produced to the Registrar of International Companies upon lawful inspection demand; certified copies are supplied to the Registrar only upon request or in connection with event-driven amendment filings.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous obligation; registers must be current and available at the registered office during business hours and produced to the Registrar within a reasonable period, normally not exceeding five business days, upon written demand.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or produce the statutory registers is an offence under the International Companies Act 1987; the company is liable to fines, the Registrar may order a formal inspection, and repeated breach can be treated as grounds for administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A standard wholesale-trading International Company (ISIC 4638) is exempt from the statutory auditor-appointment and audit-filing regime of the International Companies Act 1987; no revenue-based or asset-based audit threshold applies to a non-licensed International Company. A compulsory audit arises only where the company holds a special licence under other Samoan legislation (e.g., international bank or insurance licence) or where the board voluntarily appoints a certified auditor under the company's constitution.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The International Companies Act 1987 requires every International Company to keep accounting records respecting receipts, payments, sales, purchases and assets and liabilities sufficient to present a true and fair view of the company's transactions; IFRS is the appropriate voluntary framework for any financial statements issued to banks or trade counterparties, as Samoa applies no general local GAAP to tax-exempt international companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2023, the licensed registered agent must identify and verify beneficial owners, namely individuals owning or controlling, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the shares or voting rights, before the annual renewal; the confidential Beneficial Ownership Return is filed annually with the Registrar on the incorporation anniversary. Any transfer of shares or voting control that changes the beneficial ownership composition must be notified to the registered agent within 14 days and the register updated immediately; a revised return is then submitted at the next annual filing cycle.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Charges and Secured Interests
Minute Book of directors' and members' resolutions
Confidential Register of Beneficial Owners (kept at the registered agent's office in Apia)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 650 – USD 1,200 per annum (licensed registered agent and registered office in Apia, including preparation of the annual renewal and the annual UBO return)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable — no statutory audit is imposed on a standard International Company; a voluntary audit by a Samoan certified auditor, if required by an LC-issuing bank or trade counterparty, typically ranges USD 3,500 – USD 6,500.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying International Companies (ICs) incorporated under Samoa's International Companies Act are statutorily exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax on foreign-source trading income. For an IC engaged in bulk dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper exports, the effective Samoan corporate income tax rate is 0% on non-Samoan source revenue, provided no business is carried on in Samoa and the Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) are satisfied.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Income Tax Return (Form CIT-100) filed via the Ministry of Revenue (MOR) Taxpayer Access Portal (TAP); exempt ICs file a nil return bearing the company's Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within six (6) months after the fiscal year-end (31 December), i.e., no later than 30 June of the succeeding calendar year; the Commissioner may extend the period upon written application.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoan Taxpayer Identification Number issued by MOR to the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs quote the TIN issued to the licensed resident agent and file via the agent's TAP credentials.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross trading income derived from a source in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter WST 0; deriving Samoan-source wholesale income forfeits IC exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross export revenue from bulk dehydrated vegetables and spices sold outside Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare exempt foreign revenue and attach invoice, Swift_LC or TT wire reconciliations; no tax is assessed on this amount.
Leave nil for exempt ICs; if any Samoan-source income is inadvertently returned, only arm's-length, documented expenses are deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory tax computed on taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempt ICs enter WST 0 and attach the directors' declaration of IC exempt status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signed declaration by a director or the licensed resident agent certifying accuracy.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident director must co-sign through the Samoan resident agent; MOUs and POAs must be filed with SIFA.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fixed penalty of WST 2,000 plus a monthly surcharge of 5% of the tax outstanding (capped at 24 months); late payment interest accrues at 2% per month. Tax-exempt ICs face nominal fixed penalties for delayed nil returns but risk loss of good standing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form IC-AR) filed with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) online registry and the Registrar of International Companies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six (6) months of the anniversary of the IC's incorporation date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A - Company name and registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Official IC name and certificate of incorporation number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Match exactly the SIFA registry records; no tax assessed but the return evidences legal good standing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B - Registered office in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the licensed resident agent in Apia.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be an active licensed resident agent office; a PO Box alone is insufficient for ESR.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box C - Register of directors and shareholders
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, addresses, shareholdings, and appointment dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee shareholding and trust arrangements must be disclosed; underlying beneficial owners noted separately.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ultimate beneficial owner(s) of the shares and control rights.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain a current beneficial ownership register at the registered office for MLPA inspection within 24 hours of demand.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box E - Confirmation of no Samoan-source business
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC did not trade within Samoa during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If answered 'No', the IC is taxable and must instead file a full CIT-100.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Arrear fees accrue at WST 50 per month up to WST 1,000; after six (6) months of default the IC is liable to administrative strike-off, a reinstatement fee of WST 300, and payment of all outstanding Government fees.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends paid by a tax-exempt International Company to non-resident shareholders; the general statutory dividend withholding rate for a taxable Samoan company is 15% under the Income Tax Act 2016, but an exempt IC is outside the dividend withholding regime.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa maintains a limited DTA network (e.g., Australia via the Samoa-Australia DTA 2005 and New Zealand via the Samoa-New Zealand DTA 2011). To invoke treaty relief, the non-resident payee must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from their home tax authority and submit it, together with the payment contract and withholding declaration, to the Samoan payer and MOR through the TAP portal before the payment is made; the payer applies the reduced rate only after MOR confirms treaty qualification. For exempt IC distributions no Samoan tax arises and no TRC is required.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT for non-residents: interest 15%; royalties for IP (brands, processes, software) 15%. Under the Australia and New Zealand DTAs, interest and royalties are generally taxable only in the residence jurisdiction (0% Samoan WHT) upon TRC submission; an exempt IC pays no WHT on outward interest or royalty remittances.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File where related-party transactions exceed WST 10,000,000 (approx. USD 3.8 million) in an income year; Master File and Country-by-Country Report thresholds follow CbC guidance (consolidated group revenue above WST 100,000,000); all exempt ICs must retain contemporaneous transfer pricing records to prove arm's-length pricing on intercompany sales of dehydrated vegetables and spices.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2020 (ESR) apply. A trading IC conducting a 'distribution and service centre' relevant activity (storage, inventory, contract negotiation, invoicing for dehydrated garlic flakes and chili pepper exports) must maintain in Samoa: a physical office presence, adequate full-time employees, board meetings and records demonstrating active management and control, and sufficient operating expenditure for core income-generating activities. Exempt ICs file an annual ESR notification (nil where pure equity-holding); failure to meet substance results in denial of exempt status, assessment to 25% CIT, and penalties up to WST 50,000.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a false CIT-100, under-declaring LC or TT wire export proceeds, backdating invoices, or claiming deductions unsupported by books kept in Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax Administration Act 2016: shortfall penalty up to 200% of the tax evaded, civil interest at 2% per month, criminal fines up to WST 50,000, and imprisonment up to three (3) years; MOU/agent facilitating fraud is also sanctionable.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the resident agent are jointly and severally liable for the company's tax and penalties; fraudulent evasion exposes directors to personal fines, a court-issued travel ban (departure prohibition order), and custodial sentences up to 3 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a shell with no physical office in Samoa, no employees, board decisions made offshore, and books stored outside Samoa while claiming the 0% exempt rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withdrawal of the IC exemption, reassessment to 25% CIT on worldwide income, ESR penalty up to WST 50,000, administrative strike-off from the Registry, and adverse listing on EU/OECD high-risk grey-lists resulting in enhanced AML due diligence by correspondent banks.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally assessed for CIT and ESR penalties; the Supreme Court may issue asset-freezing orders, travel bans, and disqualification from directorship of any Samoan company for up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain the beneficial ownership register, non-cooperation with MLPA supervision, settlement of Swift_LC and TT wire trades without customer due diligence, or destruction of transactional records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2007 (as amended): corporate fines up to WST 100,000, revocation of the IC's registration, and freezing orders on the IC's bank accounts; the resident agent's license may also be suspended.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the resident agent face individual criminal fines up to WST 50,000 and imprisonment up to 7 years for willful AML non-compliance; departure prohibition orders may be issued during investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Carrying on Business in Samoa / Loss of IC Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a warehouse in Samoa, concluding contracts from an Apia office, or invoicing Samoan buyers from a place of business in Samoa while declaring nil taxable income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reclassification of the IC as a taxable domestic company; assessment of Samoan-source profits at 25% CIT plus late payment interest; retroactive assessments for up to 5 years (10 years in fraud cases) and 200% shortfall penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors participating in the misdeclaration are jointly and severally liable for the tax debts; the court may restrain personal bank accounts and assets and prohibit departure from Samoa until all liabilities are settled.
